description: The blocked-search example returns output \(y\) at input \(k\) exactly when \(k=1\) and \(y=0\); in particular, its value at zero is undefined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.blockedQ_spec (x y : ℕ) :
  y ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.PartialRecursiveFunctions.blockedQ (List.Vector.ofFn fun x_1 => x) ↔ x = 1 ∧ y = 0
